Brightly clad, woollen hatted figures climbed the paths through the Surrey pine forest, heading for the clearing marked on Don's map as OS 187:078587.

Shortly before the senior men's race it had looked as if Belgrave were not going to be able to start a team with only four runners and spectating Don Anderson on the course with 10 minutes left before the pistol was due to be fired.

It was bronze again the following year as only two relics survive (Me and Wardy – if you can call a 23-year-old a relic!)
